'''Wild Space''', also referred to as the '''Fringes''', was a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] beyond the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Wild Space had varied greatly over the years, encompassing all areas of partially explored or charted areas as known throughout various stages of [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history.

==History==
The term "Wild Space" was first used in the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]] when discussing the area of partially explored [[Realspace/Legends|space]] to the "east" of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|core]]. This area, as it became settled, eventually became known as "[[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]." Over the years, different definitions of Wild Space evolved, dependent upon what was known or unknown to the broader [[galactic community]] at the time.<ref name="TEA" />

Around [[3636 BBY]], the [[Eternal Empire]] started its [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of the galaxy from its seat of power on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Zakuul]], within Wild Space. Following the [[War against Zakuul|fall]] of the Eternal Empire in [[3631 BBY]], [[Wild Space skirmishes|skirmishes]] in Wild Space announced the coming of a [[Third Galactic War|new galactic conflict]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR510">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Inflection Point|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>

One of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] last acts was to open up much of Wild Space to more extensive exploration.<ref name="HTTES">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> 
==Definition==
Wild Space differed from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] in that Wild Space had been explored, whereas the Unknown Regions remained largely unexplored. While the Wild Space generally referred to the little-known areas that formed the boundaries of the [[galactic community]], there were pockets of "Wild Space" in any region. Worlds (and any bodies) that were barren, sparsely explored, visited, or settled, belonged to the Wild Space. Such bodies served as criminal hideouts, [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowports]], or stashes of [[smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="TEA" />

By the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the term became more fuzzy, and generally it referred to the edges of the galactic disk (in the east) and the contours bordering the Unknown Regions.<ref name="TEA" />
